summary: Teams create a complete brand identity and multimedia promotional campaign for a new digital streaming channel targeting Gen Z and young adults. Deliverables include a channel logo, motion intro, 30-second video trailer, and social media posts for YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok, all submitted virtually. Teams also present their project to judges in a videoconference.
time_limits: No more than three (3) minutes for setup
No more than ten (10) minutes for the presentation
No more than five (5) minutes for judges’ questions
Presentation will be stopped at ten (10) minutes
submission_requirements: Submit one combined PDF file containing URL link to Channel Logo, Motion Intro, 30-second video trailer, Social Media posts, Works Cited formatted according to the Style & Reference Manual, BPA Release Form(s), and AI Usage and Documentation Form
Team ID is required for all submissions
Only the team captain should complete the submission
deadlines: Event registration deadline is no later than 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time, on December 1, 2026
National submission deadline is January 15, 2027, 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time
competencies: Demonstrate knowledge of transitions, audio and video editing techniques, and the proper placement of titles and visual effects to produce a polished, professional final product
Demonstrate teamwork skills required to collaborate effectively in a professional business and virtual branding environment
Develop and implement a cohesive cross-medium promotional strategy, integrating interconnected design plans across multiple platforms and formats
Demonstrate awareness of target audience requirements and accessibility standards to ensure content is inclusive, relevant, and appropriately tailored
Apply principles of design, layout, and typography across print, digital, and multi-screen environments to produce effective, visually consistent business and media publications
Demonstrate effective persuasive and informative communication and presentation skills to convey creative and strategic decisions to a professional audience
